source: All 1,233 historical reference entries and their attribution are preserved. Revision 13 adds 79 individually reviewed spellings: 38 ordinary nominative plural nouns, two singular nouns, 37 everyday adverbs and two adjectives. Wiktionary contributors retain CC BY-SA 4.0 attribution; exact source revision links document the selected sense or plural. For four Georgian explanatory-dictionary additions, brief English glosses are original editorial wording and the linked definitions are verification sources. Sources were inspected on 2026-10-17. No automatic morphology or native-speaker sign-off is claimed. Revision 17 preserves all 1312 prior entries and adds 130 individually source-checked, owner-approved noun/adjective senses from expansion batch 02. Exact Wiktionary source revisions and concise attributed glosses accompany each addition; sources checked on 2026-10-18. No native-speaker sign-off is claimed. Revision 18 preserves all 1442 previous reference entries and adds 131 owner-approved senses from expansion batch 03; nine rejected proposals are not ingested. Fixed source revisions, concise glosses and supplemental verification links are retained. Source checks were completed on 2026-10-18; no additional native-speaker review is claimed. Revision 19 preserves all 1573 prior reference entries and adds 129 owner-approved batch-four senses. Nineteen rejected proposals are not ingested. Wiktionary fixed revisions and Georgian explanatory-dictionary URLs/content hashes preserve provenance; concise English glosses only, not full explanatory definitions. Sources were checked on 2026-10-18. No additional native-speaker review is claimed. Revision 20 preserves all 1702 prior reference entries and adds 88 owner-approved batch-five senses. Twelve rejected proposals are not ingested. Wiktionary fixed revisions and Georgian explanatory-dictionary URLs/content hashes preserve provenance; concise English glosses only, not full explanatory definitions. Sources were checked on 2026-10-18. No additional native-speaker review is claimed. Revision 24 adds 29 individually source-checked owner-approved replacement senses; the 29 removed spellings remain in reference history but are excluded from every gameplay role by revisioned word policy. Revision 25 preserves all 1819 previous entries and adds 76 owner-approved batch-six senses with their individual dictionary provenance. Short adapted glosses and attribution are retained. The 24 rejected proposals are not ingested. Revision 26 preserves all 1895 previous entries and adds 75 owner-approved batch-seven senses with their individual dictionary provenance. Short adapted glosses and attribution are retained. The 25 rejected proposals are not ingested. Revision 27 adds 277 owner-approved senses with individual source provenance from docs/VOCABULARY_EXPANSION_REVIEW_2026_10_20.json.
